notes: The spec path PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/policies/{policyId}/archive does not exist on live Clockify. GET /workspaces/{wId}/policies returns 'No static resource' (Spring-MVC routing miss) confirming the entire /policies/* subtree is absent without the 'time-off' prefix. GET /workspaces/{wId}/policies/{policyId}/archive also returns 'No static resource'. The correct live path is PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/time-off/policies/{policyId} where archival is controlled by the 'status' field ('ARCHIVED' vs 'ACTIVE'). Our clockify_time_off_archive tool correctly uses this path. The spec entry PATCH /workspaces/{wId}/policies/{policyId}/archive is an alias/alias-path that does not exist live; the real path is the time-off prefixed policy PATCH.
